velocity_propagation_notice: GenCase BI4 stores floating body angular velocity in XML, but individual particle velocities remain 0. DualSPHysics solver loads fomega at JSph.cpp:1162 and saves it into PartFloatInfo.ibi4 at step 0. InitRunGpu does not invoke KerFtPartsUpdate before saving Part_0000.bi4, so Part 0 particle velocities are 0.0 m/s. During time integration, KerFtPartsUpdate computes vr = v_lin + omega x dist (JSphGpu_ker.cu:2049-2051), producing physical velocities by Frame 1 (t=0.05s).
